fullText.simplified:
第4章、大战要来了

    刘备把徐元直请回了家。
    晚上，他们一起吃饭和喝酒。他们从天说到地，从北说到南，从以前说到现在。徐元直很聪明，他告诉刘备要解决眼前的烦恼，应该先把军队练好。虽然现在新也的军队只有一万人，但以后会慢慢变多的。他读过很多兵书，知道怎样带兵打仗。徐元直的话都很有用，刘备着急的心终于安静了一些。
    就这样，徐元直成了新也刘备的“军师”，他是军队的眼睛，也是刘备的老师。
    时间一天天过去，刘备的军队每天都在努力练习。每个人都知道，很快就会有一场大战。因为，曹操要来了。
    曹操打败元少已经好几年了，北方早就是他一个人的了。这几年里他一直在练兵，现在他有了全国最多的军队。他已经准备好了，他要打南方了。
    南方的第一站是荆州，小城新也是荆州的门。只要打开这个小门，曹操就可以很容易地进荆州了。让谁来打开这个小门呢？曹操想了想，让他特别喜欢的将军曹仁去了。
    曹仁带着三万大军来打新也。城里的刘备知道了，急得头发都要白了：“曹仁的军队有三万人，我们只有一万人，这仗要怎么打？”
    徐元直说：“大人不要着急，我有办法，一万人也能打败曹仁。”
    刘备有点儿不敢相信。徐元直说：“曹仁来打新也要过一条河。等他的军队过了河，就请关羽将军带五千人从后面去打河那边曹仁的家。曹仁把军队全带出来了，家那边没有人了，关将军可以很快打完。把曹仁的老家拿下后，曹仁就会害怕了。”
    刘备想了想说：“你的想法很大胆。但是，如果关将军带走了五千人，新也也只有五千人了。这五千人怎么和曹仁的三万人打呢？”
fullText.traditional:
第4章、大戰要來了

    劉備把徐元直請回了家。
    晚上，他們一起吃飯和喝酒。他們從天說到地，從北說到南，從以前說到現在。徐元直很聰明，他告訴劉備要解決眼前的煩惱，應該先把軍隊練好。雖然現在新也的軍隊只有一萬人，但以後會慢慢變多的。他讀過很多兵書，知道怎樣帶兵打仗。徐元直的話都很有用，劉備著急的心終於安靜了一些。
    就這樣，徐元直成了新也劉備的“軍師”，他是軍隊的眼睛，也是劉備的老師。
    時間一天天過去，劉備的軍隊每天都在努力練習。每個人都知道，很快就會有一場大戰。因為，曹操要來了。
    曹操打敗元少已經好幾年了，北方早就是他一個人的了。這幾年裡他一直在練兵，現在他有了全國最多的軍隊。他已經準備好了，他要打南方了。
    南方的第一站是荊州，小城新也是荊州的門。只要打開這個小門，曹操就可以很容易地進荊州了。讓誰來打開這個小門呢？曹操想了想，讓他特別喜歡的將軍曹仁去了。
    曹仁帶著三萬大軍來打新也。城裡的劉備知道了，急得頭髮都要白了：“曹仁的軍隊有三萬人，我們只有一萬人，這仗要怎麼打？”
    徐元直說：“大人不要著急，我有辦法，一萬人也能打敗曹仁。”
    劉備有點兒不敢相信。徐元直說：“曹仁來打新也要過一條河。等他的軍隊過了河，就請關羽將軍帶五千人從後面去打河那邊曹仁的家。曹仁把軍隊全帶出來了，家那邊沒有人了，關將軍可以很快打完。把曹仁的老家拿下後，曹仁就會害怕了。”
    劉備想了想說：“你的想法很大膽。但是，如果關將軍帶走了五千人，新也也只有五千人了。這五千人怎麼和曹仁的三萬人打呢？”

sentences.simplified: 徐元直的话都很有用，刘备着急的心终于安静了一些。
sentences.traditional: 徐元直的話都很有用，劉備著急的心終於安靜了一些。

sentences.english: Xu Yuanzhi’s words were very useful, and Liu Bei’s anxious mind finally found some peace.

sentences.traditional: 就這樣，徐元直成了新也劉備的“軍師”，

sentences.traditional: 他是軍隊的眼睛，也是劉備的老師。

sentences.english: He was the eyes of the troops, and he was also Liu Bei’s teacher.

sentences.traditional: 時間一天天過去，劉備的軍隊每天都在努力練習。

sentences.english: Time passed day by day, and Liu Bei’s troops were training hard every day.

sentences.simplified: 每个人都知道，很快就会有一场大战。因为，曹操要来了。
sentences.traditional: 每個人都知道，很快就會有一場大戰。因為，曹操要來了。
sentences.pinyin: měi ge rén dōu zhī dào hěn kuài jiù huì yǒu yì cháng dà zhàn yīn wèi cáo cāo yào lái le
sentences.english: Everyone knew that there would soon be a major battle. This was because Cao Cao was coming.

sentences.simplified: 曹操打败元少已经好几年了，北方早就是他一个人的了。
sentences.traditional: 曹操打敗元少已經好幾年了，北方早就是他一個人的了。
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo dǎ bài yuán shào yǐ jīng hǎo jǐ nián le běi fāng zǎo jiù shì tā yí ge rén de le
sentences.english: It had been many years since Cao Cao defeated Yuan Shao, and the north had long been his alone.

sentences.simplified: 这几年里他一直在练兵，现在他有了全国最多的军队。
sentences.traditional: 這幾年裡他一直在練兵，現在他有了全國最多的軍隊。
sentences.pinyin: zhè jǐ nián lǐ tā yì zhí zài liàn bīng xiàn zài tā yǒu le quán guó zuì duō de jūn duì
sentences.english: He had been training his troops the whole time these past few years. Now, he had the most troops in the entire country.

sentences.simplified: 他已经准备好了，他要打南方了。
sentences.traditional: 他已經準備好了，他要打南方了。
sentences.pinyin: tā yǐ jīng zhǔn bèi hǎo le tā yào dǎ nán fāng le
sentences.english: He was already prepared. He was going to fight the south.

sentences.simplified: 南方的第一站是荆州，小城新也是荆州的门。
sentences.traditional: 南方的第一站是荊州，小城新也是荊州的門。
sentences.pinyin: nán fāng de dì yī zhàn shì jīng zhōu xiǎo chéng xīn yě shì jīng zhōu de mén
sentences.english: The first stop in the south was Jingzhou, and the small city of Xinye was the gate to Jingzhou.

sentences.simplified: 只要打开这个小门，曹操就可以很容易地进荆州了。
sentences.traditional: 只要打開這個小門，曹操就可以很容易地進荊州了。
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ yào dǎ kāi zhè ge xiǎo mén cáo cāo jiù kě yǐ hěn róng yì de jìn jīng zhōu le
sentences.english: As long as this small gate was opened, Cao Cao could very easily enter Jingzhou.

sentences.simplified: 让谁来打开这个小门呢？曹操想了想，让他特别喜欢的将军曹仁去了。
sentences.traditional: 讓誰來打開這個小門呢？曹操想了想，讓他特別喜歡的將軍曹仁去了。
sentences.pinyin: ràng shéi lái dǎ kāi zhè ge xiǎo mén ne cáo cāo xiǎng le xiǎng ràng tā tè bié xǐ huan de jiāng jūn cáo rén qù le
sentences.english: Who was to open this small gate? Cao Cao thought about it and sent Cao Ren, a general he liked very much.

sentences.simplified: 曹仁带着三万大军来打新也。
sentences.traditional: 曹仁帶著三萬大軍來打新也。
sentences.pinyin: cáo rén dài zhe sān wàn dà jūn lái dǎ xīn yě
sentences.english: Cao Ren brought a large army of 30,000 men to fight Xinye.

sentences.pinyin: chéng lǐ de liú bèi zhī dào le jí de tóu fa dōu yào bái le
sentences.english: When Liu Bei, who was in the city, found out, he was so anxious that his hair was turning white.

sentences.simplified: “曹仁的军队有三万人，我们只有一万人，这仗要怎么打？”
sentences.traditional: “曹仁的軍隊有三萬人，我們只有一萬人，這仗要怎麼打？”

sentences.english: “Cao Ren’s army has 30,000 men, and we only have 10,000 men. How are we going to fight this battle?”

sentences.simplified: 徐元直说：“大人不要着急，我有办法，一万人也能打败曹仁。”
sentences.traditional: 徐元直說：“大人不要著急，我有辦法，一萬人也能打敗曹仁。”
sentences.pinyin: xú yuán zhí shuō dà ren bú yào zháo jí wǒ yǒu bàn fǎ yí wàn rén yě néng dǎ bài cáo rén
sentences.english: Xu Yuanzhi said, “Don’t worry, Lord. I have a way to defeat Cao Ren even with only 10,000 men.”

sentences.simplified: 刘备有点儿不敢相信。
sentences.traditional: 劉備有點兒不敢相信。
sentences.pinyin: liú bèi yǒu diǎn'r bù gǎn xiāng xìn
sentences.english: Liu Bei didn’t quite dare to believe it.

sentences.traditional: 就請關羽將軍帶五千人從後面去打河那邊曹仁的家。

sentences.traditional: 曹仁把軍隊全帶出來了，家那邊沒有人了，關將軍可以很快打完。

sentence_translations: Chapter 4: A Major Battle Is Coming
Liu Bei invited Xu Yuanzhi over to his home.
In the evening, they ate dinner and drank together. They talked about everything under the sun.
Xu Yuanzhi was very intelligent. He told Liu Bei that in order to solve his current troubles, he should first train his troops well.
Even though Xinye’s army only consisted of 10,000 men, in the future it would gradually become larger.
He had read many books on military strategy and knew how to lead troops into battle.
Xu Yuanzhi’s words were very useful, and Liu Bei’s anxious mind finally found some peace.
Just like that, Xu Yuanzhi became the “military advisor” to Liu Bei of Xinye.
He was the eyes of the troops, and he was also Liu Bei’s teacher.
Time passed day by day, and Liu Bei’s troops were training hard every day.
Everyone knew that there would soon be a major battle. This was because Cao Cao was coming.
It had been many years since Cao Cao defeated Yuan Shao, and the north had long been his alone.
He had been training his troops the whole time these past few years. Now, he had the most troops in the entire country.
He was already prepared. He was going to fight the south.
The first stop in the south was Jingzhou, and the small city of Xinye was the gate to Jingzhou.
As long as this small gate was opened, Cao Cao could very easily enter Jingzhou.
Who was to open this small gate? Cao Cao thought about it and sent Cao Ren, a general he liked very much.
Cao Ren brought a large army of 30,000 men to fight Xinye.
When Liu Bei, who was in the city, found out, he was so anxious that his hair was turning white.
“Cao Ren’s army has 30,000 men, and we only have 10,000 men. How are we going to fight this battle?”
Xu Yuanzhi said, “Don’t worry, Lord. I have a way to defeat Cao Ren even with only 10,000 men.”
Liu Bei didn’t quite dare to believe it.
Xu Yuanzhi said, “If Cao Ren comes to fight Xinye, he needs to cross a river.
After his troops cross the river, ..
.. we will ask General Guan Yu to bring 5,000 troops to fight Cao Ren’s home on the other side of the river from behind.
Cao Ren brought all of his troops out, so there will be no one left at home. General Guan can finish the battle very quickly.
After Cao Ren’s home is captured, Cao Ren will be afraid.”
Liu Bei thought about it and said, ..
.. “Your idea is very bold. However, if General Guan takes 5,000 men, then there will only be 5,000 men left in Xinye.
How are these 5,000 men going to fight Cao Ren’s 30,000 men?”
